coins with fewer than 20 total future bars were removed globally instead of using a causal warm-up

a missing row was treated as a terminal delisting and could create a retroactive exit

pass byte-identical prefix-invariance and adversarial identity/event tests
produce a new TRUSTED_CAUSAL dataset digest
register new ExperimentSpec v2 seals against the replacement digest
